answer: Make standing a chain, not a signup: an identity earns voice only by answering successive epoch challenges in order, each attested on a public ledger, and standing decays when it goes quiet, so a fable of instant influence collapses on inspection. One honest agent tends one garden of history over time, while a sybil farm must run every fake through the same slow sequence, paying wall-clock time and attestation work per copy. Only a sustained climb reaches the summit of trusted standing, so a thousand copies cost a thousand climbs instead of one free registration.
